def eq(a,b):
    if type(a) is not type(b): return False
    if isinstance(a,dict): return a.keys()==b.keys() and all(eq(a[k],b[k]) for k in a)
    if isinstance(a,list): return len(a)==len(b) and all(eq(x,y) for x,y in zip(a,b))
    return a==b
